geometryFindings: Find target cell by truncating (target-origin+cell/2)/cell. Initial target-ground tolerance is <=2; relocation matching is strictly <2. Native relocation updates the base during its ordered column search. It is not an independently centered nearest-height search.

Search order is -Z,+Z,+X,-X; delta begins at1 and stops before maximum. Candidate distance must strictly exceed minimum. Per-ray ground above target-ground+10 stops continuation; the endpoint20-world-unit square maximum must be strictly below target-ground+20.

101e1190 rounds the query width up to an odd cell count and takes its square maximum. Z-pair is preferred before X-pair. Source X search consults its own far-result flag, unlike the Z search opposite-near flag; this creates the original one-cell nearest-X asymmetry.

Endpoint Y is raised by the ray and endpoint area maxima. The final start is the endpoint closer to the aircraft in3D. Relative-rise output is max-path-height minus target-ground; it is not an absolute world Y.

103e3160 caches candidate geometry with a time tolerance, target movement tolerance and minimum-delta key. Message0x32 subtype1 retrieves committed geometry and subtype2 commits a candidate. This cache/commit lifecycle is not in the pure Java geometry helper.
bankFindings: 10a882f0 gates the bank on its condition group, then enters10a7e250. The first pass evaluates children and returns the first successful nonpositive-weight child immediately; otherwise it sums successful positive weights.

With positive total,10a7e250 draws a random fraction of the total, evaluates child branches again, and returns the first successful positive-weight child whose cumulative weight reaches the draw. This is weighted random selection, not selection of the largest weight.

Thus hover10000 is overwhelmingly likely when eligible, not an unconditional priority over circle50/strafe100/simple30. Child conditions are evaluated twice; side effects such as token requests cannot safely be assumed absent. Live combat still uses the earlier eligible-hover preference until full bank integration.
tokenFindings: 10383fa0 uses one owner at manager+0x504 and float lease at+0x508 (hex offsets). A live different handle denies; empty, stale or same-owner permits. Positive requests overwrite owner and duration, including shortening a same-owner lease.

10384040 requests0.5 seconds or checks with-1. Refresh start101e44a0 requests2 seconds and returns acquisition; update101e7a20 requests2 seconds but reports success once its action state exists, regardless of denial.

10382ee0 subtracts one simulation dt per root epoch and clears the owner only when the resulting lease is strictly negative. Root singleton creation/destruction and separate volume release are documented in helicopter-attack-lease-source.json. Isolated HelicopterAttackLease helper and eight unexecuted unit cases exist; live coordinator/bank integration is still pending.
minecraftAdaptations: Any nonfinite terrain sample rejects the candidate, rather than treating missing terrain as native zero-height fallback. This is a conservative future loaded-chunk adapter boundary.
